strategy_lab.evidence.title: Per-leg delivery target declarations
strategy_lab.evidence.intro: Each leg declares the exact delivery interval its evidence must address. A target is never inferred from a series name or product label: historical selection matches the declared name, hub, tenor, price basis, role and exact half-open interval, and only rows available at the decision time. Supported bases: a fixed explicit UTC interval, or a rolling gas day resolved through the canonical calendar with offset 0 (current) or 1 (next).
strategy_lab.evidence.unsupported: Not yet supported: month and quarter tenor rolls, and automatic reference-source name mapping. Declarations that need them are refused rather than approximated.
